test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A man sold a radio and a TV set together for Rs. 30,400. thereby making a profit of 25% on the radio and 10% on the TV set. By selling them together for Rs. 30,700, he would have made a 10% profit on the radio and 25% on the TV set. The cost price of the radio is:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price in 1st case = Rs. 30400

Selling price in 2nd case = Rs. 30700

**Calculation:**

Let price of radio be Rs. 100x and TV be Rs. 100y

According to question,

125x + 110y = 30400 ----(i)

110x + 125y = 30700 ----(ii)
